steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F). Line a baking sheet with parchment.
Soak the raisins in hot water 5 minutes, until plump, then drain and chop them roughly.
In a large bowl, beat the softened butter with the sugar 1 minute, until pale and creamy. Beat in the egg.
In another bowl, whisk the wheat flour, the rolled oats, the cinnamon and the baking soda.
Add the dry mixture to the butter mixture with the raisins. Stir just until no dry flour shows.
Drop tablespoons of dough onto the sheet, 5 cm apart, and flatten each one slightly with wet fingers.
Bake 11 to 13 minutes, until the edges are golden and the centres still look soft.
Cool 5 minutes on the sheet, then on a rack. Not for under 12 months; halve for toddlers. Keeps 4 days in a tin.
